integrity: Proof identities, Sturm isolations, parameter bounds, Routh-Hurwitz tests, and a Lyapunov resultant are independently reconstructed by the accompanying exact-arithmetic SymPy script; infinite conclusions use the analytic proof. The source supplies the original vector field and reduction.
scientific_limitations: Only equilibrium sink coexistence and origin-centered global exponential attraction near the negative fold are established. No classification of other invariant attractors, basins, finite perturbations or publication priority.
title: A sharp negative-parameter bistability window in the ETM-3D quadratic flow
